exchangeFormat: Club members: call /(club age) + club acronym (e.g. /104 SJRA). Non-club members: call + name. Everyone works everyone. Bands: all except 60/30/17/12m; repeater contacts allowed (= phone). FT8/JT65 excluded (no exchange).

scoringRules.scoreFormula: (Σ QSO pts × unique Club Members worked) + (Club Stations worked × 100). Pts: CW 3, Phone 1 (SSB/FM/AM/USB/LSB & repeater), Digital 2 (PSK/RTTY; FT8/JT65 excluded — no exchange). Every QSO scores (club or not). Multiplier = count of DISTINCT club-member base callsigns worked — a club member signs 'call /###' so the received exchange carries the club-age digits; a non-club member sends only a name (no digit). Each club member counted once as a multiplier regardless of band/mode (also counts in the QSO total). Worked once per band/mode (no cross band/mode). Claimed/running — the SJRA K2AA committee re-adjudicates. NOT applied (off-log): the +100-per-approved-Club-Station bonus (the approved Club-Station appendix list is not in the published rules — counted by the sponsor; not fabricated here); club-age/acronym vs name and international acronym-only club members are resolved by the sponsor's log check.
